nodes.label: General brief rules (Aturan umum brief) for the sub-sessions of the scope 009 coordination: the fixed part of every brief; the brief wins where it differs
nodes.source_file: docs/scope/coordination/009 - A new project from the foundation.brief-umum.md

nodes.label: Sub-session flow: read the brief, the general rules, then the role file in the main checkout, call the skill the brief names, and only then work in the existing worktree and branch; a reused session runs git merge main first
nodes.source_file: docs/scope/coordination/009 - A new project from the foundation.brief-umum.md

nodes.label: Project adjustments: the role files were written for another Rust project; cargo xtask, stackly_testkit, clients/swift, evidence/, prd.md and test-preferences.json do not exist here; evidence is the commands and output in the report
nodes.source_file: docs/scope/coordination/009 - A new project from the foundation.brief-umum.md

nodes.label: First turn of a new session: on standby only read the brief, the general rules and the role, end the turn with STATUS: standby and send nothing; the lead sends start
nodes.source_file: docs/scope/coordination/009 - A new project from the foundation.brief-umum.md

nodes.label: Main checkout and knowledge graph: run graphify query and graphify explain against the main checkout's graphify-out/graph.json before reading files, and never change a file in the main checkout
nodes.source_file: docs/scope/coordination/009 - A new project from the foundation.brief-umum.md

nodes.label: Lead address: Mobile Foundation Scaffold [f5cda4]; full reports, questions and needs-decision go there through SendMessage
nodes.source_file: docs/scope/coordination/009 - A new project from the foundation.brief-umum.md

nodes.label: Always forbidden for sub-sessions: docs/scope/, AGENTS.md, graphify-out/, spec content other than the Status line and the verify.md ticks (checker only), other specs, and files outside the brief's allowed list
nodes.source_file: docs/scope/coordination/009 - A new project from the foundation.brief-umum.md

nodes.label: Graph and commit: the lead fulfils the AGENTS.md /graphify . --update rule when merging to main; sub-sessions never run graphify update and never stage anything under graphify-out/
nodes.source_file: docs/scope/coordination/009 - A new project from the foundation.brief-umum.md

nodes.label: Decisions in auto mode: for an ambiguous AC read the spec's rationale.md, take the reading closest to the AC text and record it under Tafsiran AC; needs-decision goes to the lead only when the AC text or a spec decision must change
nodes.source_file: docs/scope/coordination/009 - A new project from the foundation.brief-umum.md

nodes.label: Manual steps rule: GUI apps, GitHub web pages, physical devices, signing, installing tools, repository settings, push and triggering or repeating workflows are done only by the user or the lead; gh is read-only; headless simulators and emulators are allowed; a failed or flaky step is reported failed, not manual
nodes.source_file: docs/scope/coordination/009 - A new project from the foundation.brief-umum.md

nodes.label: Derivation only on a copy: init-project.sh with --name rewrites README.md and the verification record and removes graphify-out/, so that form runs only in a temporary clone in the session scratchpad; --check and --test are safe in the worktree
nodes.source_file: docs/scope/coordination/009 - A new project from the foundation.brief-umum.md

nodes.label: Disk rule: 32 GiB free at the start; only the checker runs full native builds, one at a time; below 10 GiB free stop and report blocked; remove target/, build/ and apps/android/**/build and the temporary clone before reporting done
nodes.source_file: docs/scope/coordination/009 - A new project from the foundation.brief-umum.md

nodes.label: Process rule: stop only the processes, simulators and emulators you started, name them F009-<session> and delete them afterwards; suites longer than 10 minutes run detached with nohup
nodes.source_file: docs/scope/coordination/009 - A new project from the foundation.brief-umum.md

nodes.label: Verification before reporting: scripts/test.sh must exit 0; build-ios.sh simulator, device and test in light and dark when apps/ios/ changed; build-android.sh assemble and connectedDebugAndroidTest in both night modes when apps/android/ changed; git status clean and the diff against main limited to ownership files
nodes.source_file: docs/scope/coordination/009 - A new project from the foundation.brief-umum.md

nodes.label: Skill panels: AskUserQuestion does not wake the lead, so every panel is answered from a fixed list of answers or sent to the lead as needs-decision
nodes.source_file: docs/scope/coordination/009 - A new project from the foundation.brief-umum.md

nodes.label: Commit rule for sub-sessions: one commit per step, an imperative English subject without prefix like the repository history, plus the Co-Authored-By trailer
nodes.source_file: docs/scope/coordination/009 - A new project from the foundation.brief-umum.md

nodes.label: Report rule: one final report per item through SendMessage following the coordinate skill's report template; done is valid only when everything is committed, the working tree is clean and the last git merge main was run; the first line is STATUS
nodes.source_file: docs/scope/coordination/009 - A new project from the foundation.brief-umum.md

nodes.label: Session model per role: developer claude-opus-5-5 medium, tester claude-opus-5-5 high, checker verify claude-fable-5-2 high, debugger claude-fable-5-2 medium
nodes.source_file: docs/scope/coordination/009 - A new project from the foundation.brief-umum.md
